# Crystal: This is how you find scrap with crystal for the challenges

![Crystal: This is how you find scrap with crystal for the challenges](/uploads/322_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

For some daily and weekly challenges you need crystal. You also need crystal to make film for the ProSnap Deluxe camera, cryolator ammunition, X-01 and Ultrazit helmet repairs. Here you will find a list of scrap items that contain crystal and a list of places where you can search.

## Scrap items, with crystal

- Broken camera
- Broken ProSnap camera
- Crystal decanter
- Crystal shards
- Floater Freezer pus bag
- Microscope
- Magnifying glass

## Locations with Crystal Scrap items

Here are some examples with locations:

- Clancy Manor (crystal decanters, cameras, magnifying glasses)
- Whitespring Mall (Merchant)
- Cabins north of Whitespring Resort (cameras, magnifying glasses)
- Black Bear Lodge (crystal decanter)
- Appalachian Antiques (crystal decanter)
- Charleston Capitol Building (crystal decanter)
- Riverside Manor (crystal decanter)
- Helvetia (crystal decanter)
- Hornwright Estate Safe Room (crystal decanter)
- Garrahan Estate (crystal decanter)
- Watoga Community Center (crystal decanter)
- AVR Medical Center (microscope)
- Arktos Pharma (microscope)
- Ella Ames Bunker (microscope)
- West Tek (microscope)
- Morgantown High School (microscope)
- Morgentown Airport (Microscope)
